scope: development Generator-Critic comparison; no confirmation or release
unblind_prerequisites: exact frozen source-only queue identity and source refs
CriticFreezeReceipt hash and manifest verify, all supplied output files verified
review_id/source_ref one-to-one with source-only packet, absent or unresolved retained
all target native IDs resolve in same pinned target release; no unverified ID or cross-cycle join
explicit review role and exposure history recorded
explicit unblinding authorization; no mutation of generator or critic files

adjudication.ambiguous: retain distinct admissible target sets and conditions; no forced single target

evaluation.retrieval_coverage: queries with >=1 generated candidate / all evaluated queries; not recall
evaluation.candidate_recall_at_k: queries with at least one expert-eligible target in top-k / queries with adjudicated eligible target in the fixed target universe
evaluation.edge_precision: adjudicated correct edges for specific directional relation and purpose / adjudicated proposed edges
evaluation.unmatched: report separately source cases with no eligible target, not dropped from coverage
evaluation.weighted_metrics: frequency weighted only with actual sampling probabilities and frequency definitions; macro counts by stratum
evaluation.intervals: pre-specify binomial or design-based interval and clustering before confirmatory audit; zero observed errors not zero risk
evaluation.threshold_and_sample_size: HOLD_PI_AND_EXPERT_PROTOCOL_REQUIRED before independent confirmatory set is opened
evaluation.developer_queue_44_or_enriched: not representative and not confirmatory; report development disagreements and review burden only

release_guard.required_next: independent adjudication, applicability and uncertainty, rights checks, non-regression, purpose-scoped release and explicit authorized owner

note: File separation is not proven access control. Existing Gemini previously audited code; no strict independence claimed. Never read Critic outputs in generator execution.
